_about: GX Cluster V4.1 registry (schema 2) — the single source of truth for nodes, the Mia runtime, model packs, public aliases, serving profiles and reasoning levels. Dashboard, orchestrator and gateway must read from this file; no hardcoded model/node names in code. Contract: docs/ARCHITECTURE-V41.md section 2. Loader/validator: legenex/models/registry.py. Facts are pinned to the revisions below and to state/MIA-RUNTIME.md (verified 2026-09-27). Supersedes the schema-1 alias table of the retired L-6/L-10 stack (gx-mini/gx-code/gx-fast/gx-reason, llama-swap, SGLang); that content lives in git history under tag pre-deepseek-v41-rebuild-20260927.

fabric.notes: NCCL traffic uses BOTH ConnectX-7 rails (192.168.100.x / 192.168.101.x) with a PER-NIC GID index; the all-zero GID entry dies ~60 s into a run with ibv_modify_qp errno 61 (state/EVIDENCE.md). GID index 3 is the proven pin. Tailscale is management/SSH only and must never appear in a model or NCCL path.

mia-dsv41.notes: vLLM-based 2x DGX Spark EXL3 kit, TP=2, nnodes=2, master port 29521. OpenAI API on head :8888 is LOOPBACK ONLY — never public. Lifecycle owned by the orchestrator (DOWN->ACQUIRING->READY->RELEASING), no boot autoload. Weights sync WEIGHT_SYNC=rsync over LAN SSH.
